Noah (People Ops): Quick update: we're running short 30m calibration clinics ('calib clinics') next week to speed decisions. Clinics are focused blocks for quick alignment + edge-case questions. Signup: https://rwd.co/calib-clinics.
Tess (Manager): Nice. Are these clinics replacing org micro-calibs or are they supplemental?
Noah (People Ops): Supplemental. Think of them as triage sessions for ambiguous cases only. Bring 1-3 edge cases.
Diego (Eng): Do we still need the written calibration note when we present in a clinic?
Noah (People Ops): Yes — 2-line note required: `evidence | rubric level | ask` — paste into the session doc before your slot.
Pri (Recruiter): Heads-up: contractor conversion flags need a "budget cleared" tag before cross-org. Please mark conversions on the form so we can gate them.
Tess (Manager): Any change to review form cutoff? Our timezone team is late-night heavy.
Noah (People Ops): Cutoff unchanged: forms must be submitted by 2026-04-08 23:59 UTC. We added a late-window for emergencies only — see the extension form.
Diego (Eng): Embargo rules? Want to be sure managers don't accidentally post.
Noah (People Ops): Embargo = no sharing of final ratings publicly until manager 1:1s begin on 2026-04-11 09:00 UTC. You can share developmental feedback earlier.
CalBot: Reminder: clinic signup closes in 48h. Add your edge cases and docs to avoid being bumped. :bell:
Pri (Recruiter): If a manager can't make their clinic slot, what's the handoff payload?
Noah (People Ops): Minimal handoff: current draft comment + 2 peer snippets + preferred recommendation. Put in backfill column and tag @people-ops. We will auto-assign a floater 24h before session.
Tess (Manager): Will recordings be available? Some folks will be in APAC.
Noah (People Ops): Recordings allowed, org-internal only, auto-deleted after 30 days. Add a short note in the session doc if you record.
Diego (Eng): Thanks — signing up now.
Noah (People Ops): Thanks everyone. We'll post a 1-page clinic facilitation cheat sheet after the first run. Ping if you need an on-call facilitator.
